title: Monthly Wholesale Trade: Sales and Inventories (August 2026 data) — the last monthly wholesale print on the pre-AIES basis, 10:00 a.m. ET
source: EST: census.gov/economic-indicators/calendar-listview.html fetched direct 2026-09-06 (HTTP 200, 91,396 bytes), row "Monthly Wholesale Trade: Sales and Inventories | October 8, 2026 | 10:00 AM | August 2026", release code A202610081000, reference A202608. Corroborated by the Atlanta Fed's GDPNowcastDataReleaseDates.xlsx PostedUpdates sheet, whose 2026-10-08 row reads "Wholesale trade" — this release owns a GDPNow vintage of its own. Filed estimate per the lane's no-self-confirm limit on an event discovered in-sweep. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: DISCOVERED during the mtis-2026-10-15 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06). Proposed for two measured reasons. First, it is the wholesalers' leg of the proposing print, 34.5% of the aggregate by June-2026 inventory weight (Census timeseries1.xlsx: $944.7B of $2,740.2B), publishing seven days ahead of it. Second, and specific to this edition: census.gov/wholesale dates the 2023/2024 AIES wholesale restatement — both the revised not-adjusted and the corresponding adjusted estimates — to 2026-10-26, so this 2026-10-08 print is the LAST ordinary monthly wholesale release on the pre-AIES basis, the mirror of wholesale-trade-2026-11-09 (a sibling proposal), which is the first on the new one. A basis break sits between the two, and any series stored from this print is superseded eighteen days later. The calendar tracks the December-data twin (wholesale-trade-2026-12-09, with its own ledger); the August-data edition was untracked. Impact LOW and symbols empty on the same measured grounds as the sibling Census entries: no macro-keyed house playbook (grep re-run 2026-09-06, 0 hits) and no instrument attaches. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
